## Findings

**Compound identity (CID 4058):** Meperidine (pethidine) — ethyl 1-methyl-4-phenylpiperidine-4-carboxylate, C₁₅H₂₁NO₂.

**Structural analysis:** The molecule has one tertiary amine (N-methylpiperidine, no N–H) and one ester carbonyl/alkoxy oxygen (no O–H). RDKit SMARTS matching for `[#8;H1]` and `[#7;H1]` returns **zero matches**, and there are zero hydrogens on any N or O atom.

**Cross-validation:**

| Source | HBD for CID 4058 |
|---|---|
| PubChem PUG-View computed record (Cactvs 3.4.8.24 — the value shown on the compound page) | **0** |
| RDKit Lipinski NumHDonors | 0 |
| ChEMBL (CHEMBL607, meperidine) | 0 |
| PubChem REST `/property/HBondDonorCount` | 1 ← anomalous |

**On the discrepancy:** I stress-tested both PubChem endpoints across 10 compounds (aspirin, ibuprofen, caffeine, nicotine, lidocaine, rofecoxib, estradiol, glucose, adenosine, meperidine). REST and PUG-View agreed on **every compound except CID 4058**. So this is not a systematic endpoint problem — it is an isolated inconsistency specific to this record, where the REST property service returns 1 while PubChem's own displayed Cactvs-computed value is 0. The chemistry unambiguously supports 0.

**Answer: 0.**
